system.description: Slowly bringing his splayed fingers together, with arcs of light reaching out between his fingertips, the weaver speaks a word of binding, and luminous filaments like glowing cables of light coalesce around the target in a shifting mesh. The Exalt's player rolls (Intelligence + Occult) against the target's Dodge DV to bind the target in this web. Blocks are inapplicable as the web forms around the target from every direction. The netting does not impair the target's mobility in any fashion. Every time the target spends Essence, however, he suffers damage of a type determined at the protocol's weaving. It's either one level of bashing per mote of additional Essence spent by the target or one level of lethal damage for every two motes of Essence spent (with expenditures of a single mote causing no damage). This damage can be soaked with the target's Essence rating or appropriate Charms. This protocol does not interfere with activities that don't require Essence expenditure such as Excellencies supplemented by Infinite (Ability) Mastery, nor does it interfere with Essence the target has already committed. This spell lasts for one scene and is ineffective against beings of greater Essence than the weaver.
